content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure works because it's built on a foundation of open-source tools and blockchain-based payments, which provide a decentralized and censorship-resistant way to process transactions. By leveraging GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build a fully functional online store without relying on traditional payment gateways. This means that they can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy this infrastructure, you'll need a few key components: a domain name, a GitHub account, and a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency to accept payments in, such as USDT on Tron or Binance Coin. Additionally, you'll need to set up a Google Sheet to store your orders and a Google Drive folder to deliver your products. Thankfully, many of these components can be obtained for free or at a low cost.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your online store, which can be done using a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script. You'll also need to set up a Supabase database to store your orders and a Google Drive folder to deliver your products. This will ensure that your customers receive their products quickly and efficiently, while also providing you with a secure and scalable way to manage your orders.
You can accept USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live and processing your first transaction is an exciting milestone in deploying your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. To go live, you'll need to test your online store and payment pipeline to ensure that everything is working correctly. Once you've done this, you can start accepting payments from your customers. Remember to keep an eye on your transactions and update your NOWPayments account accordingly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure requires careful planning and execution. To scale effectively, you'll need to monitor your transactions and adjust your payment pipeline accordingly. You may also need to upgrade your NOWPayments account or add more Cloudflare Workers to handle increased traffic. By scaling your infrastructure correctly, you can handle large volumes of transactions and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
